name: How long does it take to frame and complete an interior partition wall?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to frame and complete an interior partition wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building a basic partition wall in an open room typically takes one to two days for framing rough layout, top and bottom plates, studs, and door rough openings. The overall timeline extends when factoring in the full interior finish sequence. Once framing stands, electrical rough-ins and low-voltage wiring must go in before drywall can hang. Drywall installation, multi-coat taping, drying cycles, texturing, and final painting usually add another three to five working days before finish carpentry can install trim and hang doors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framing the stud skeleton takes one to two days, while full drywall finishing, texturing, trim carpentry, and painting require several additional days for complete curing and finish work.
